question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, and if so should it be opt-in or default-on?
rationale: The feature is feasible within the plugin, but it changes retrieval semantics, adds config/default surface, creates persistent FTS index lifecycle policy, and overlaps with external plugin and memory-core reranker directions.

options.title: Implement opt-in plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit default-off config, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Implement default-on parity
options.body: Enable hybrid retrieval by default only with upgrade proof that vector recall, duplicate checks, and existing LanceDB stores do not regress.

options.title: Defer advanced retrieval externally
options.body: Keep official memory-lancedb vector-only and route advanced LanceDB hybrid or rerank behavior to an external plugin or future ClawHub package.

recommendation.title: Implement opt-in plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit default-off config, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from current memory-lancedb history, the original memory-core hybrid work, and prior review context on this issue.
